Army soldier killed in Mizoram road rage incident

An Army soldier, Zakaria Lalhriattluanga, serving in the Assam Regiment and posted in Jammu and Kashmir, was killed in a road rage incident in Mizoram's Kolasib district. He was returning home on vacation. The 29-year-old soldier was allegedly assaulted and killed by a group of youths. His family has demanded justice, stating he was the sole breadwinner for his elderly parents.
